records.selectionReason: Official USDA leaf-vegetable record for raw amaranth; chosen as the primary same-source raw profile.

records.officialDescription: Amaranth leaves, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

records.selectionReason: Official USDA same-source cooked leaf profile, specifically boiled, drained, and without salt; chosen as the secondary prepared-state profile.

selectionSummary: USDA was selected because it provides official, same-source raw and cooked amaranth-leaf records. CFCT was not used.
